Roborock Qrevo Pro replacement filters

Two washable filters.

View filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: Roborock’s U.S. filter page and this Amazon title both explicitly name Qrevo Pro. These washable filters fit inside the robot dustbin; they are not dock dust bags.

Replace when: Roborock recommends cleaning every 2 weeks and replacing every 6–12 months, or sooner if a filter is damaged or stays clogged after cleaning.

Before buying: Confirm Qrevo Pro in the current listing details. After rinsing, let the filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it. The Amazon snapshot had no featured offer, so check the live buying options.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

U.S. robot and dock
The U.S. manual identifies robot model QR1PES and dock EWFD16LRR; match both model codes before choosing parts.
Main brush
Qrevo Pro uses a conventional single rubber roller. The verified Amazon fit listing is a third-party bundle that includes one roller; it is not a single-brush pack or a DuoDivide assembly.
Filter vs. dock bag
The washable dustbin filter and disposable dock bag are separate parts. Do not order a bag as a robot filter or infer fit from a different Qrevo variant.
Mop cloths
The round spinning cloths are separate from their plastic mounts and drive components; compare the cloth shape and attachment.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Qrevo Pro maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Qrevo Pro cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Main brushEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
Side brushMonthly3–6 months
Washable filterEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
Mop clothsAs needed1–3 months
Dock dust bagDisposableAs needed

Let a rinsed washable filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it. Switch the robot off before servicing brushes or mop components.

Before you order

How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Pro?

The U.S. manual lists robot model QR1PES and dock model EWFD16LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

Does the Qrevo Pro use a DuoDivide main brush?

No. Roborock’s Qrevo Pro manual shows a conventional single main roller. The Amazon-linked third-party kit includes one rubber roller; it is a bundle, not a single-brush package.

Are these all genuine Roborock parts?

The filter, black side brushes and dust bags are Roborock-branded. The main-brush kit and mop cloths are third-party products. DustMigo has not physically tested third-party fit or durability.

Are Qrevo S Pro dust bags compatible with Qrevo Pro?

Do not assume so. Qrevo Pro and Qrevo S Pro are different variants. The linked Roborock bag title explicitly lists Qrevo Pro; recheck the exact model and 2.7 L pack on Amazon.
